findings.summary: Struct field still assigned from the now-deleted `total_bitrate_mbps` variable, which no longer compiles.
findings.mechanism: The diff renames/replaces the old `total_bitrate_mbps` computation with `video_bitrate_mbps` (line 277), but the `SourceInfo` construction at line 340 still reads `video_bitrate_mbps: total_bitrate_mbps` — `total_bitrate_mbps` was never declared in this function, so this is an unresolved-name compile error and the crate fails to build.

findings.summary: Audio-subtraction fallback silently reverts to the (biased) container total when audio_bps == 0.
findings.mechanism: When the video stream lacks its own bit_rate and no audio stream reports a bit_rate (audio_bps == 0), the match falls through to `None => container_bps`, reproducing the exact overstatement bug this change is meant to fix for any multi-audio-track file whose audio streams simply don't expose bit_rate (common for lossless/PCM or copied tracks).
